text: {"features":[{"name":"Role-specific motivation","description":"How convincingly the letter explains why this exact role, team, and company appeal to the applicant.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows generic interest in security or software work, with little concrete explanation of why this specific role at Google is appealing."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in the role but leans mostly on broad enthusiasm or paraphrases of the posting."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a clear reason for wanting this role and ties that reason to at least one concrete aspect of the team or job."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Builds credible motivation around several specific aspects of the role, team, or Google security environment."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a memorable and well-grounded reason for applying that clearly grows out of the applicant's prior experience and priorities."}]},{"name":"Role understanding","description":"How accurately and specifically the letter reflects the actual responsibilities described in the posting.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Refers to security or backend work broadly without showing a clear grasp of the role's specific responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Touches on one or two relevant responsibilities, such as automation or security tooling, but stays high-level."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows reasonable understanding of several core duties, such as vulnerability handling, agentic tooling, or Go back-end work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Connects prior experience to multiple specific responsibilities from the posting in a way that feels informed and targeted."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates nuanced understanding of the role as a mix of security automation, vulnerability response, agentic systems, and Go and Python implementation."}]},{"name":"Security engineering philosophy","description":"How thoughtfully the letter expresses the applicant's principles for building secure, reliable systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers little beyond generic enthusiasm for security, with no clear view of how security engineering should be practiced."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States a broad belief about security or quality, but keeps it abstract or only loosely connected to the role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Expresses a recognizable philosophy, such as secure defaults, rigor, or security as engineering, with some relevance to the examples given."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Articulates a clear and mature view of security engineering and ties it to past choices or preferred ways of working."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a distinctive, role-relevant philosophy of security engineering that feels deeply internalized and consistently reinforced by the letter's examples."}]},{"name":"Platform leverage orientation","description":"How strongly the letter values building foundational systems whose benefits extend across many teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little interest in foundational systems or organization-wide impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions scale or broad impact briefly, but not as a central reason for fit."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly expresses interest in infrastructure or work whose benefits extend across many teams."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows a strong platform mindset by linking past work or preferences to broad downstream leverage."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Frames the applicant's engineering identity around foundational leverage and makes central security tooling feel like a natural destination."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"How well the letter frames security engineering as helping developers do the right thing with less friction.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents security mainly as review or enforcement work, with little attention to helping developers succeed."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at supporting other teams, but does not clearly explain how security should reduce developer friction."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States that secure defaults, lower toil, or proactive support for developers matter."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly frames security work as making the secure path easier for engineers or reducing manual burden for others."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows a mature enablement mindset in which security tooling is explicitly designed to help developers adopt best practices rather than be policed after the fact."}]},{"name":"Formal academic preparation","description":"How advanced and technically relevant the academic preparation presented in the letter is.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents a bachelor's degree as the main academic credential and gives no added academic signal beyond the minimum qualification."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Presents a bachelor's degree with framing that suggests solid technical preparation despite no advanced degree."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a master's degree in computer science or a closely related field as relevant preparation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a master's degree with unusually strong technical framing or other academic signals above a typical master's profile."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a doctorate in computer science or a closely related field as clear advanced technical preparation."}]},{"name":"Relevant professional tenure","description":"The amount of directly relevant professional software-engineering experience the letter presents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents about three years of relevant software engineering experience, meeting the minimum comfortably but offering limited tenure signal."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Presents about three years of experience but uses it to show meaningful responsibility or unusually role-relevant work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents around five years of directly relevant experience."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents around five years with clear maturity signals or around seven years in a more straightforward way."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents about seven years of relevant experience and uses that tenure to signal seasoned readiness for the role."}]},{"name":"Production lifecycle ownership","description":"How strongly the letter evidences testing, maintaining, launching, and owning production software across its lifecycle.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions only limited ownership of a small number of production services, with little sense of end-to-end responsibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some hands-on exposure to testing, maintenance, and launch work, but with modest scale or thin detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives solid evidence of work across the production lifecycle for multiple services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong lifecycle ownership through breadth, progression, or clear responsibility for several production systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents extensive end-to-end ownership of many production services or unusually mature responsibility for launching and operating them."}]},{"name":"Go backend depth","description":"How convincingly the letter establishes Go as a core language for relevant back-end engineering.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go but gives little evidence of depth, centrality, or relevant system-building in it."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States that Go is important in the applicant's work, but provides only minimal context on what was built with it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid production use of Go for services or backend systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a primary or daily language with clear responsibility for relevant production systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Establishes deep, role-specific Go expertise through sustained ownership of backend systems and concrete architectural or operational context."}]},{"name":"Python engineering depth","description":"How convincingly the letter establishes Python as a production language for automation, services, or analysis.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Omits Python or mentions it only in passing without evidence of meaningful use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States some Python experience but gives little sense of scope, reliability, or production relevance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for tooling, automation, analysis, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a major working language with multiple concrete production uses."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong, role-relevant Python depth by tying it to substantial automation, services, AI agents, or clearly production-grade engineering."}]},{"name":"AI application maturity","description":"How well the letter demonstrates practical experience applying AI in production settings.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no meaningful evidence of AI work or mentions AI only as a general interest."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions having built with AI or language models, but without detail on scope, reliability, or context."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes concrete AI or language-model features that were shipped or supported in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production AI experience plus awareness of reliability, evaluation, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates mature applied-AI judgment by pairing shipped AI systems with concrete discussion of trust, safeguards, evaluation, or predictable operation."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"How well the letter shows experience designing agents and the systems that bound their behavior.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agentic work or uses the term without showing design responsibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents at a high level, but gives limited evidence of architecture, boundaries, or controls."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows direct experience building agentic tooling with at least some design responsibility."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes agent architectures concretely, including how agents act and how services supervise, constrain, or audit them."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong agentic-systems fit by clearly explaining task decomposition, permissions, guardrails, or auditability across Python agents and Go services."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability response automation","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates direct automation of vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or similar security-response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of work on vulnerability intake, triage, or related response workflows."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at security automation, but without a concrete vulnerability-response example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes automating some meaningful part of vulnerability reporting or triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial ownership of vulnerability-response automation with clear operational improvement for the team."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents end-to-end automation of vulnerability handling, such as intake, classification, deduplication, routing, or largely self-serve triage, with strong leverage for security work."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"How convincingly the letter shows hands-on experience assessing the security of systems and following findings through.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions security interest but gives little or no evidence of actual assessment work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims security review experience in broad terms without method, scope, or follow-through."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes real assessment work, such as threat models, design reviews, or service reviews."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows hands-on assessments plus remediation verification, attack-surface thinking, or review of systems the applicant did not originally build."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong assessor credibility by treating assessments as rigorous engineering work with concrete methods, attacker perspective, and follow-through on fixes."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"How well the letter evidences skill with data structures and algorithms through concrete engineering examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention data structures or algorithms, or does so only as an unsupported claim."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States strength in algorithms or data structures but gives only thin supporting detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one concrete example of an algorithmic improvement, redesign, or better structure choice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows practical algorithmic fluency through a clear example tied to performance, scale, or tractability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes algorithmic skill feel like a real working strength by giving a high-signal example and linking it to better system design or a substantial simplification."}]},{"name":"Supplemental security credibility","description":"How strongly the letter adds extra evidence of security skill through certifications, offensive practice, or similar signals.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Adds no extra security signal beyond ordinary software engineering claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Provides a lighter extra signal, such as a baseline certification or casual offensive practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides a clear additional signal, such as serious CTF participation or a recognized security certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Offers strong supplemental validation through OSCP-level certification, high-level offensive practice, or multiple supporting signals."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Combines especially strong extra signals, such as rigorous offensive certification plus substantial competitive or practical attacker-minded activity, in a way that materially strengthens the case."}]},{"name":"Independent technical initiative","description":"How strongly the letter shows sustained technical initiative beyond core job duties.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little evidence of sustained technical initiative outside normal job duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small side project or occasional upstream fix, but with limited depth or duration."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows credible extra-work initiative through a useful side project, repeat open-source contribution, or similar self-driven effort."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents sustained initiative through substantial personal systems work, real open-source maintenance, or clearly ambitious self-directed building."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates exceptional self-driven engineering through demanding long-running projects, widely used open-source stewardship, or similarly ambitious independent systems work."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How concrete the letter's claims are, including specific projects, actions, systems, or outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on abstract claims and broad self-descriptions, with little concrete support."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mixes some specifics with many claims that remain unsupported or hard to picture."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Regularly supports claims with concrete tasks, technologies, or examples."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses multiple specific, role-relevant examples that make accomplishments easy to visualize and believe."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Grounds nearly every major claim in concrete systems, actions, or outcomes, making the case highly testable and credible."}]},{"name":"Narrative cohesion","description":"How well the letter is structured into a clear, persuasive, and internally consistent case for fit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as disjointed, list-like, or poorly sequenced, so the overall case for fit is hard to follow."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic structure but feels choppy, repetitive, or only loosely integrated."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a coherent overall case with understandable flow from background to fit."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses structure well to build a persuasive argument, with sections that clearly reinforce one another."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers a highly cohesive narrative in which the opening, evidence, and closing all reinforce a clear through-line toward this role."}]},{"name":"Mechanical polish","description":"The level of proofreading, grammar, spelling, and sentence-level professionalism.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent spelling, grammar, or wording errors that repeatedly distract from the content."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains several noticeable errors or awkward constructions that somewhat weaken professionalism."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has a generally professional surface with a few errors or clunky phrases."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is polished and easy to read, with only minor lapses that do not distract."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is exceptionally clean and professional at the sentence level, with essentially no distracting mechanical issues."}]}]}
